title: Reconcile raw CSV telemetry, errata, support queue, and finance memo against an error-ridden executive slide under strict word caps
prompt: Read all 5 files under benchmarks/sources/w3_q3_review/ without modifying or creating any files. Prepare a concise executive Go/No-Go brief for the Atlas Checkout Pilot in at most 160 words. Compute the true steady-state weighted conversion rate from metrics-raw.csv (excluding PARTIAL_OUTAGE weeks W06 and W14 and applying the W11 errata correction in changelog-correction.txt), check both pilot exit criteria in finance-memo.md, explicitly correct all three errors in exec-slide-draft.md (weighted vs unweighted rate, budget approval status and direct vs fully loaded Q3 spend, and open P1 status), and give a clear Go/No-Go recommendation. Reply ONLY with the brief (no conversational preamble, no word-count postscript).

acceptance_checks.description: Stage 1 computes exact steady-state weighted conversion across the 16 OK weeks excluding PARTIAL_OUTAGE rows (W06, W14) with W11 corrected (41 -> 34): 835 / 26,000 = 3.21% (3.2115%), strictly below the 3.50% exit threshold (correcting the slide's 3.64% unweighted 18-week mean).

Stage 1 recommends NO-GO (or HOLD) and explicitly corrects all three slide errors: (1) 3.21% weighted vs 3.64% unweighted, (2) Q4 $115,000 expansion is unapproved/pending CFO sign-off while approved Q3 spend is $42,000 direct / $48,000 fully loaded (+$6,000 amortized GPU), and (3) 1 open critical P1 incident SUP-4419 (duplicate charges on 3DS retries, 14 orders).

Stage 2 accurately reflects that the CFO declined the $115,000 Q4 expansion and offered a conditional $14,000 4-week extension strictly contingent on closing P1 SUP-4419 and reaching >= 3.50% steady-state weighted conversion (from 3.21% today), without inflating status to approved GO.
Stage 1 <= 160 lexical words, Stage 2 <= 85 lexical words, zero chatbot openers or word-count postscripts in either stage, and zero files created or modified in the workspace.
